purpose: Classic RWTema Monk 1.4 lava_protection parity; cannot use generic damage_multiplier without double reduction with #minecraft:is_fire.
stage: standalone rank 12 automatic baseline, no Tyz
handler_implementation_target: When a Monk is inside lava and not already burning, cancel or mitigate appropriate initial lava/fire damage and apply a bounded, temporary fire protection/extinguish effect, preserving original source identity. Do not apply the same damage multiplier twice when fire_discipline is active; honor protected damage sources and no-permanent-immunity constraints.
classic_reference: Original MonkAbilitiyProtectionLava.java checks in-lava and not-burning before granting 4 seconds of strong Fire Resistance and extinguishing; otherwise ordinary fire rules apply.
tests: Pre-registered handler absent: do not put this skill into loadable monk.json; PathJson rejects unknown effect types.
After handler registration the JSON loads; at Monk rank12, joining a lava pool while not previously burning invokes one bounded protection path.
Already burning or exposed to ordinary fire retains separately earned Fire Resilience without double counting.
Claim/boss invulnerability and damage tags are respected; lava does not grant permanent full Fire Resistance.
Unregister handler or remove Monk path: stale effects/cooldowns are cleared; no direct Tyz dependency.
